description: This file implements functions for generating and broadcasting backup restore events, including initializing and shutting down an event producer, and broadcasting restore step events as JSON messages to listeners.

methods.name: startBackupRestoreEventProducer
methods.description: Initializes the event producer for backup restore events, ensuring thread safety.

methods.name: stopBackupRestoreEventProducer
methods.description: Shuts down the event producer for backup restore events, ensuring thread safety.

methods.name: broadcastRestoreEvent
methods.description: Creates and broadcasts a restore step event as a JSON message to listeners, including event code, value, key, and success status.
